SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱2,100,000 – ₱2,600,000 (Varies by trim, engine, and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,694 × 1,866 × 1,691 Wheelbase (mm): 2,701 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.0 L 4-Cylinder DOHC i-VTEC Gasoline
Maximum Output: 154 hp Maximum Torque: 189 Nm
1.6 L 4-Cylinder i-DTEC Diesel (available in select variants)
Maximum Output: 160 hp Maximum Torque: 350 Nm
Transmission: CVT (Gasoline) / 9-speed Automatic (Diesel) Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) or All-Wheel Drive (AWD, depending on variant)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Approx. 600–750 kg (light towing only, depending on engine/variant)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 500–600 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 57 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Infotainment: 7”–9” touchscreen (depending on trim), Apple CarPlay / Android Auto
Speakers: 6–8 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Discs / Solid Discs
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Multi-Link rear
Tires / Wheels: 235/60 R18 Alloy (standard), 19” alloys available on higher trims
